title: Initial Python RAG+agent quickstart scaffold (layout, config, README)
author: Monica Patel
description: Summary: This PR introduces the initial scaffold for the Python “RAG + agents” quickstart template. It focuses on a maintainable folder layout, environment/config parsing with safe defaults, and a README skeleton that gets users to a working local run quickly. Retrieval and agent loop are included as placeholders with clearly marked TODOs (functionality fleshed out in follow-up PRs). Motivation: We want a production-minded starting point that is easy to extend while keeping vendor lock-in minimal. This PR intentionally keeps scope tight (no OTel yet; no real vector store yet) to unblock iteration on conventions. What’s included: 1) Template folder layout with minimal “app” entrypoint. 2) Config management via env vars with validation and typed defaults. 3) README skeleton + troubleshooting placeholders. 4) Placeholder retriever interface + in-memory stub implementation. 5) Placeholder agent loop with tool registry shape and guardrails placeholders. Non-goals (for this PR): Real vector DB adapters, tool schema validation, tracing/metrics/logging, retries/timeouts defaults, CI smoke tests. Those land in subsequent PRs. Implementation details: - Python 3.11 baseline. - `pydantic-settings` used to define a single `Settings` object sourced from `.env` + process env; early validation fails fast with actionable error messages. - App is a small FastAPI server with one endpoint for now (`POST /query`) returning a simple JSON response; streaming is explicitly deferred. - Retrieval path is structured so we can drop in real adapters without rewriting the handler. - Agent loop is a minimal “planner/executor” skeleton with a max-iterations constant and a tool registry interface, but tool calling is stubbed. Files / structure: - `python/rag-agent/README.md`: Skeleton README with setup steps, env vars, and TODO placeholders for observability + deployment docs. - `python/rag-agent/pyproject.toml`: Template dependencies and entrypoints. - `python/rag-agent/.env.example`: Example env vars (no secrets) to guide setup. - `python/rag-agent/src/rag_agent_template/__init__.py` - `python/rag-agent/src/rag_agent_template/settings.py`: `Settings` model + env parsing. - `python/rag-agent/src/rag_agent_template/server.py`: FastAPI app + route wiring. - `python/rag-agent/src/rag_agent_template/retrieval/base.py`: `Retriever` protocol + return types. - `python/rag-agent/src/rag_agent_template/retrieval/inmemory.py`: Stub retriever returning hardcoded chunks. - `python/rag-agent/src/rag_agent_template/agent/loop.py`: Stub agent loop and tool registry interface. - `python/rag-agent/src/rag_agent_template/agent/tools.py`: Placeholder tool definitions and registry wiring. - `python/rag-agent/scripts/run_local.py`: Convenience script for local run. - `python/rag-agent/tests/test_settings.py`: Basic validation tests (missing env var, invalid values). Env vars (v0): - `REDWOOD_API_KEY` (required; fails fast if missing) - `REDWOOD_BASE_URL` (optional; defaults to hosted) - `REDWOOD_MODEL` (optional; placeholder value documented) - `APP_PORT` (optional; defaults to 8000) - `RAG_TOP_K` (optional; defaults to 4) Notes on safety: - `.env.example` explicitly excludes real keys and includes guidance to use local env only. - README warns not to log env vars and not to commit `.env`. - No request/response payload logging in this scaffold yet (to avoid accidental PII leakage before redaction conventions land). Screenshots / local test: - `uv run python scripts/run_local.py` and `curl -X POST localhost:8000/query -d '{"question":"..."}'` returns a stubbed answer with citations from the in-memory retriever. Follow-ups planned: - OTel instrumentation + structured logging + redaction defaults (ENG-4184). - Retry/timeout defaults and streaming robustness (ENG-4186 / SDK alignment). - Real retriever adapters + chunking defaults. - Agent tool calling + tool schema validation and guardrails. Checklist: - [x] Template layout matches proposed architecture conventions (retrieval/agent/config split). - [x] README skeleton created (setup, env vars, local run). - [x] `.env.example` provided (no secrets). - [x] Minimal tests added for settings validation. - [ ] Observability hooks (next PR). - [ ] Deployment recipes (later).
commits_summary: Scaffold python/rag-agent template directory and packaging
Add pydantic settings + env var validation
Add FastAPI server skeleton and /query handler
Add placeholder retriever interface and in-memory implementation
Add placeholder agent loop + tool registry shapes

Also, please add a tiny smoke test that imports the app so we catch missing deps. Monica Patel (author): Good call. Updated README with a “What’s implemented in v0” section and added a minimal import test to ensure the server module imports cleanly. Wei Chen (review): README steps are clear. Request: add explicit note about not committing `.env` and where to put the API key. Also consider mentioning model pinning will come later. Monica Patel (author): Added a “Secrets & safety” callout and a short section on model configuration with a note that pinning/fallback guidance will be added in a follow-up. Ibrahim Khan (review): For settings, can we validate `APP_PORT` range and ensure `RAG_TOP_K` is >0? Also, please avoid defaults that encourage high concurrency (even if not implemented yet). Monica Patel (author): Added validation constraints for `APP_PORT` and `RAG_TOP_K`. No concurrency settings are introduced in this PR. Kaitlyn Nguyen (review): Thanks for keeping logging minimal. Ensure `.env` is in `.gitignore` for this template directory; also `.env.example` should not contain anything that looks like a real key. Monica Patel (author): Added `.gitignore` in the template directory and changed the example key format to `your_key_here` with an explicit warning.
